description: Leader-q exit sequence: with text in the prompt the app.exit binding is disabled and the chord suspends the textarea (D-02, v2 keymap semantics: <leader>q resolves through the base layer to session.queued_prompts — the q is dispatched, not typed, and the draft survives); once the draft is cleared, <leader> (ctrl+x) followed by q dispatches app.exit and tears the renderer down
source: test/app-lifecycle.test.tsx (exit ordering) + src/config/keybind.ts (app.exit = 'ctrl+c,ctrl+d,<leader>q', session.queued_prompts = '<leader>q', leader default ctrl+x) + src/app.tsx app.exit layer enabled only while the prompt is empty + terminal-pane.tsx:144 (focused surfaces skip leader strokes — the chord fires over a non-empty draft)
